title: Actor Schema V0
description: The machine block of an ACTOR artifact: a declared identity and its typed attributes. Written from what ACTOR artifacts declare; it replaces a description that expected a role and forbade the attributes every actor carries.

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.

supersedes.description: FQDN of the artifact this one stands in place of. A declared relation between two exact identities, not a resolution rule: references stay exact, and a superseded artifact is unreachable rather than absent.

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.

core.description: An actor declares identity and attributes only (AC_IDENTITY_ONLY). It carries no permissions, authority or execution rights (AC_NO_AUTHORITY_SEMANTICS).

required.description: Whether the field must be present

default.description: Value used when the field is absent

value.description: The attribute's literal value. Identity is a compile-time fact, so it is never a runtime path.
